prose: Bloomberg’s report, as indexed by Techmeme, says Apple plans to introduce smart glasses at WWDC and ship them by the end of 2027, with third-party iPhone apps and Siri AI central to the experience. The article body was inaccessible. These are attributed plans, not an Apple announcement, confirmed shipping date or verified specification.
highlights: Report is attributed to Bloomberg sources
App integration is the indexed emphasis
Shipment timing remains a reported plan
Pricing and final hardware are not established
